overview.description: The WisdomTree Japan Opportunities Fund (OPPJ) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the WisdomTree Japan Opportunities index. The fund tracks an index of Japanese stocks selected based on fundamental criteria and potential geopolitical advantages. The fund employs a dynamic currency hedge to minimize fluctuations between the USD and JPY. OPPJ was launched on Jun 28, 2013 and is issued by WisdomTree.
